prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized stone cairn / waypoint marker. Three simple rounded stones
stacked in a stable pyramidal arrangement — a large stone at the
bottom, a medium stone on top of that, a small stone at the apex.
Simplified app-icon geometry: each stone is a flat saturated palette
color (can be slightly different tones of the same hue, or alternating
palette colors), sharp clean edges. Centered in the icon area. No
shading, no ground line, no surrounding scene.
formatted_prompt:
STYLE: flat vector app icon; modern UI icon register matching Phosphor Fill / SF Symbols Filled; bold crisp geometry; single centered subject on plain off-white canvas with generous padding; no gradients, no textures, no brushwork
SUBJECT: stylized stone cairn of three stacked rounded stones in stable pyramidal arrangement; bottom stone largest and widest, middle stone medium, top stone smallest; each stone a distinct flat bold palette color — bottom stone vivid red (#FF0000), middle stone vivid blue (#0000FF), top stone vivid yellow (#FFFF00); every stone rendered as a clean flat filled shape with sharp precise edges and slightly rounded corners suggesting smooth river stone geometry; stones stacked centered on a vertical axis, touching cleanly with no gaps
CONTEXT: isolated app icon; no ground line, no shadow, no surrounding scene; centered composition on plain off-white background
COLOR: bottom stone vivid red (#FF0000) bold flat fill; middle stone vivid blue (#0000FF) bold flat fill; top stone vivid yellow (#FFFF00) bold flat fill; off-white (#FFFFFF) canvas; strong color separation between each stone layer
DETAILS: every edge crisp and deliberate; silhouette readable as a cairn waypoint at 16px; interior shapes flat secondary-color fills only; no stroke outlines needed given high contrast between stone colors; adult proportions, clean geometry
CONSTRAINTS: flat bold fills only; zero gradients; zero textures; zero ink marks; zero weathering; zero background elements; icon must resolve clearly at 16px minimum
